# HumAIn Logic

> Calm, plain-language guide to AI for everyday people and small businesses: a task-based AI tool directory, a sourced AI news feed, an AI Job Safety Tracker, and a weekly newsletter.

Data is rebuilt automatically (news every few hours). Proposed license: CC BY 4.0 for editorial text and tracker data (pending owner sign-off); tool logos and third-party text excluded. Please cite "HumAIn Logic" with a link to https://humainlogic.com.

## Tools directory
- [Browse tools](https://humainlogic.com/tools): all tools by category
- [Browse tasks](https://humainlogic.com/tasks): every task, each with matching tools
- [Tools API](https://humainlogic.com/api/tools.json): JSON list of all tools
- [Tasks API](https://humainlogic.com/api/tasks.json): JSON task taxonomy with tool slugs

## AI Job Safety Tracker
- [Tracker](https://humainlogic.com/tracker): outlook per job (Mostly steady / Changing / Big shift ahead), with sources
- [Jobs API](https://humainlogic.com/api/jobs.json): JSON outlooks, editorial year-range estimates, confidence, sources
- [Methodology](https://humainlogic.com/methodology): how outlooks are assigned

## Guides
- [All guides](https://humainlogic.com/guides)
- [What is AI? A plain-language introduction](https://humainlogic.com/guides/what-is-ai): What artificial intelligence actually is, how today's AI chat tools work, what they're good and bad at, and why you don't need to be technical to use them.
- [AI for small business: practical first steps](https://humainlogic.com/guides/ai-for-small-business): Where AI can genuinely save a small business time and money, which affordable tools to try first, and how to start without big risks or big budgets.
- [Staying safe with AI: privacy, scams, deepfakes and checking answers](https://humainlogic.com/guides/staying-safe-with-ai): Simple habits to protect your privacy, spot AI-powered scams and deepfakes, and double-check what AI tools tell you.
- [Getting started with AI chat assistants: prompting basics](https://humainlogic.com/guides/getting-started-with-ai-chat-assistants): How to choose a free AI assistant, write clear requests (prompts) that get useful answers, and avoid common beginner mistakes.
- [AI and your job: how to prepare with confidence](https://humainlogic.com/guides/ai-and-your-job): What research really says about AI and jobs, why most roles will change rather than vanish, and practical steps to build skills and stay ready.
